implementation: Consume pending ID-sorted rows through leased Records. Fresh by-ID and single-cohort input-evidence maps build directly with SortedBuilder when no retained membership, queued mutation or prior result root requires the general reducer.

Gather compatible pinned primitive wire lanes into native merge columns, one column at a time. Preserve SQL NULL, dictionary values and floating-point bits. Decimal, JSON null, heterogeneous and unsupported encodings fall back before allocation. Tiles below 16 rows retain scalar encoding.

native_method.build: Debug native macOS arm64 Zig 0.17.0; identical benchmark source per frozen before/after pair, baseline production paths restored before baseline compilation then restored to candidate in finally. Both configurations are synchronous, shared-runs, direct typed payloads, no parallel capture.
native_method.timer: Thread CPU includes add, finish, complete leased drain, every key/ordinal/value oracle and Sort.deinit. Manager construction and executable startup excluded.
native_method.oracle: 64-lane permuted ranks, exact i64 above 2^53, signed f64, bool, five 96-byte ordinal/column-tagged strings and SQL NULL every 17 rows; every row checked.
native_method.sampling: Three alternating pairs per workspace; compression none and Snappy within every executable; no task-owned build/test/cleanup overlaps; other host work uncontrolled.
native_method.interpretation: Retain the measured 4-MiB kernel gain. The 1-MiB case is flat and tiny-workspace results are mixed. The initial ungated diagnostic overlapped builds/tests and is excluded from evidence.

publication_method.timer: HTTP table create through first queryable complete target revision; 25-ms readiness polling. Startup, fixture creation and complete SQL verification excluded.
publication_method.oracle: Every row and all ten columns checked in disjoint 64-row SQL intervals; fixture, runner, config, definition and complete result digests identical within cohort.
publication_method.sampling: Three alternating pairs per cohort; fresh server storage, retained OS caches; no task-owned builds/tests/cleanup overlap; other host activity uncontrolled.
publication_method.configuration: Default 4-MiB coordinator workspace, 1-MiB metadata preference, 1-GiB working-set cap; local Parquet/FsStore Debug.
